custom_preconds:
Organization has the ShopCoach feature flag enabled.
A custom role "WO Full" exists (Work Orders + Work Order Lines: Create & Edit ON) with a confirmed user.
At least one Work Order exists on the org.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the WO-Full user and open the same Work Order's Lines tab.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The in-page ShopCoach Line Builder panel (.shop-coach-line-builder) IS present.

custom_steps_separated.content: As the WO-Full user, open the New Line dialog.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Build Lines button (data-test-id=button_shop_coach_line_builder) IS present.

title: ShopCoach Build Lines entry point shown for role with Work Order Lines Create & Edit
